ms.report:
Resubmitting our PoA.
We have finalized Unit based testing and property based testing for all five Smart Contracts

Links to the documentation and testing folder for every Smart Contract seperatly:
・Merkle Tree Contracts
・Tests - https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/plutarch-merkle-tree/tree/main/test
・Single Asset Staking Contracts
・Tests - https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/single-asset-staking/tree/main/test
・Linear Vesting Contracts
・Tests - https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/linear-vesting/tree/main/test
・Bridge Contracts
・Tests - https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/bridge-template/tree/main/test
・Yield Farming Contracts 
・Tests - https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/yieldfarming/tree/master/test

Outputs found in every repository:
・A comprehensive suite of property-based tests for each smart contract. Tests cover a wide range of input scenarios and properties of the contracts, ensuring robustness and reliability.
・A dataset containing test data and input values used in property-based testing. Includes various inputs and edge cases designed to validate correctness of the contracts.
・Detailed report summarizing the results of property-based testing. These reports should indicate which properties were tested, which passed, and which failed.
・Evidence that property-based testing covers critical properties and behaviors of the smart contracts. This ensures that the contracts meet their intended specifications and behave as expected.
・Documentation explaining the purpose and significance of each property-based test. This documentation should help developers understand what aspects of the contracts are being tested and why.
・Documentation on how to use the property-based testing framework. This includes instructions for running property-based tests, configuring test parameters, and interpreting test outcomes.

Please let us know if anything else is needed for PoA.
